next_action.description: Run the CivitAI SHA256 licence check on the five Chroma style LoRAs. Ask Fabio to turn the VPN ON first (CivitAI region-blocks the UK), and tell him when the CivitAI work is finished so he can turn it off. Do NOT trust the system clock while the VPN is on: derive the offset once from `gh api rate_limit -i`. For each hash: GET https://civitai.com/api/v1/model-versions/by-hash/<sha256> to get modelId, then GET https://civitai.com/api/v1/models/<modelId> for the permission flags. The by-hash endpoint returns a STUB whose flags are all null, so you MUST follow modelId. The decisive flag is Image (may the user sell what they generate). Record the table in a new docs/models/chroma/licences.md mirroring docs/models/klein/licences.md, add a credit block in loraDeps.js for any allowNoCredit false creator, and only then do the R2 upload.

key_decisions: Tier is a FILE axis, not a runtime one. Flash and Hyper are two separate checkpoints, so generate_chroma.py bakes ClownModelLoader.model_name plus Input_Tier per output file. Two loaders in one graph would force BOTH downloads, because ComfyUI validates every combo widget at submit time even on a lazily-skipped branch (execution.py value_not_in_list).

Depth uses a FLUX ControlNet checkpoint, not a LoRA. Proven from the weights: Chroma applies control residuals like FLUX (comfy/ldm/chroma/model.py:221-226 and :257-262), latent_format is Flux, and Union Pro 2.0 x_embedder is [3072,64] which equals Chroma hardcoded in_channels (model_detection.py:294). Klein refcontrol LoRA and Krea2 control-LoRA are model-specific and do NOT port; Krea2 expands img_in so it is dimension-locked.

The ControlNet is sourced from HUGGINGFACE, never R2. FLUX.1-dev is non-commercial AND the BFL paid commercial terms still forbid distributing to third parties by any means, so no licence purchase unblocks rehosting. Linking the origin repo is what ComfyUI, Invoke and Fooocus do.
wf_type numbering mirrors Klein and Krea2 with slots 4 and 5 left dead, so a shared op never means a different branch depending on which model is selected.
SetUnionControlNetType is a silent no-op on Union Pro 2.0 because the mode embedding was removed. Verified from the safetensors header, not from the model card.
constraints: THE 5 STYLE LoRA HASHES, already computed, do NOT re-hash 1GB. chroma-style-bwsketch = Complex_Chaotic_BW_Stuff.safetensors = 69b5226e7ce7f31b11db8a2279edbd26f6623fe7ce7b49050f5a2159f037cb91. chroma-style-lenovo = lenovo_chroma.safetensors = df934b1a366206daa3b5dcfef7c84efd9e75ca19d00867d7fe24fa2bb233fdc9. chroma-style-cinema = CHROMA_Absolute_Cinema.safetensors = d725af79c044e881a0d810b561248f07475e52a529b30d5763849f5191ab6ffa. chroma-style-brushwork = Fine_Tactile_Brushwork.safetensors = 7b594e78fb929a6dc6cc6a3dd94f87ba1489ae2774afd38d6514bf3476be307e. chroma-style-anime = Chroma-Anime-v3.safetensors = d1c5756064bdbc6738bf24e6152c011b8ddaf0b93585963c381c3216318900fb.

Weights live at G:/CubricModels/loras/chroma/styles/. Six MORE LoRAs sit in that folder unused (Chroma_Voyager_86_retro_anime, Mixed_Illustrations, PSYCHEDELIC, Sketch_chroma, crhoma_wai_style). They were tested and rejected. Do NOT wire them.

CivitAI region-blocks this machine. Agent WebFetch and WebSearch can NEVER reach it; only shell tools go through the VPN. The VPN also skews the system clock (14h measured once) and throttles R2 uploads about 15x, so do the CivitAI half first and have the VPN turned OFF before the upload.
Chroma is UN-INSTALLABLE until the R2 upload lands, because the loraDeps URLs 404. This is committed state, not a bug to re-diagnose.
The FLUX ControlNet dep must NEVER be mirrored to R2. It is the only non-permissive weight in the app, and it has no mirror fallback, so its sha256 is the only guard against an upstream re-upload.
Never hand-edit workflow JSON. Graph changes go through the user in the ComfyUI editor, then re-export and sync.
